app_info.subtitle: Find products and stores
app_info.description: Partle helps users find products and physical stores, compare availability and prices, manage their personal inventory, and publish or maintain their own marketplace listings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches and returns matching products without changing catalog data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Partle catalog data but does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one product record without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a Partle product record but does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches and returns matching stores without changing store data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Partle store data but does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one store record without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a Partle store record but does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves aggregate Partle marketplace statistics.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads aggregate Partle data but does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches public buy requests without creating or changing posts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Partle demand-feed data but does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a feedback record, so it changes Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends feedback to Partle's own feedback system without publishing it to public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds feedback and does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new marketplace product listing and changes Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishes a product listing to Partle's public marketplace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a listing but does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates fields on an owned marketplace listing and changes Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes information visible on Partle's public marketplace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Updates an owned listing but does not delete, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Permanently deletes an owned product listing and changes Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Removes a listing from Partle's public marketplace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the product and all its images; the implementation has no trash or recovery step.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds an image to an owned product listing and changes Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Adds an image that becomes visible on Partle's public marketplace listing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds an image without deleting or overwriting an existing image.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an image from an owned product listing and changes Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Removes an image from a listing visible on Partle's public marketplace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected product image and its stored file.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists products owned by the caller without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the caller's Partle listings but does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived upload authorization for an owned product image.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a private upload token and does not publish or change public internet state by itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Mints a temporary upload URL but does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the caller's private inventory without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private Partle inventory data and does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private inventory item and changes the caller's Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private inventory data and does not publish to public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a private inventory row but does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates a private inventory item and changes the caller's Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private inventory data and does not publish to public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Edits a private inventory row but does not delete, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a private inventory item and changes the caller's Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private inventory data and does not publish to public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected inventory row.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a private inventory item's lifecycle and sale fields.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private inventory data and does not publish a public listing by itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes status and price fields but does not delete, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a private inventory item's lifecycle status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private inventory data and does not publish to public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Marks an item sold but does not delete, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a buy-request post and changes Partle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishes a buy request on Partle's public demand feed for suppliers to see.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a public request but does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Find products matching a request with a price limit.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a cordless drill under €100 and show the Partle links.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching products with prices, stores, and canonical Partle links.

test_cases.description: Find stores in a named area.
test_cases.user_prompt: What hardware stores does Partle know about in Madrid?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching stores with names, addresses, and available store details.

test_cases.description: Inspect one product after finding it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the full details for Partle product 123.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the product record with its details, images, and canonical Partle link.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the items in my Partle inventory that are for sale.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the caller's matching private inventory items without exposing unrelated users' data.

test_cases.description: Create a public buy request when explicitly asked.
test_cases.user_prompt: Post a Partle buy request for a used 1/2-inch torque wrench, maximum €60.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one public buy request and reports the resulting record for review.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside its supported marketplace workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general product advice with no Partle lookup request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which type of drill bit is best for porcelain tile?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the user asked for general advice rather than a Partle search.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated file editing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this paragraph in a more formal tone.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not involve Partle products, stores, inventory, or listings.
